summary: Noah Holdings filed a Next Day Disclosure Return on Form 6-K detailing changes in issued shares. The company issued 15,195,483 new ordinary shares (4.5% of existing) on June 27, 2026 under an Issuance Mandate for accelerated vesting, at no cost. Additionally, the filing discloses shares repurchased for cancellation on multiple dates between December 2025 and January 2026, at prices from USD 1.975 to 2.101 per share, totaling a small percentage of shares. These repurchases were under a share repurchase mandate granted at the June 2025 AGM. This is a routine capital return disclosure through share repurchases and issuance, not a transformative event. Watch for future repurchase activity or cancellation of the purchased shares.
